text: The content of the very report should include such aspects as a review, the significance of selected subject, involved contents of the research, knots and uniqueness of the research, expected results, potential innovational points, so and so, followed by more than 50 cited articles. 5.1.4 The evaluation of the report: 7 senior professionals, with more than 4 professors, are organized to evaluate the report as audiences. With the permission of the 7 senior professionals, the report will be turned into public in result. 5.2 Mid-term report In the mid-term of the research, the reporter ought to deliver a report on the evolution of the research, which is regarded as a mid-term assessment, so as to guarantee the goals achieved in time. The reporter is supposed to be warned, as it were, with a yellow card on the playground, on the condition that he or she cannot fulfill the demands in the due time. 5.3 Thesis answer for the degree 5.3.1 Precondition: A. Three or above papers in the core periodical, published or accepted. And achieve the demand of "the research achievement quantification norm of the academic degree delegation of the Shanghai University". B. Participating more than 30 academic reports and be defined as qualitication. C. Completed the thesis of the doctor's degree, preliminarily read by the supervisor then reread by 2-3 professors, and passed. 5.3.2 Pass the pre-answer of the thesis.
